nit: rename `n` to `pageSize`.

Edit: also, this loop uses `i <= items.length`, so the last page reads one past the end and returns `undefined`. Please fix the bound and add a test for an exact multiple of `pageSize`.

instructions: Optional: If you reject a code review suggestion, journal why: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <reason>'`.

`$CHANGE_MESSAGE`: one sentence on what changed. Run even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --reply-thread-ids PRRT_edited_ask --message "$CHANGE_MESSAGE" --require-sha HEAD`
